text:
maria_ops: Heads-up — procurement put this batch on hold. Vendor sent invoice that doesn't match the PO pricing and finance flagged it. invoice: INV-90321, PO: 45032. holding 8x H100s in transit. can someone confirm if we should release non-affected SKUs? :thinking:

liam_pl: are the 8 H100s all from the same AWB? if they're split across pallets we might be able to release the unaffected units to the Dedicated pool.

maria_ops: AWB is `AWB-GB123456789`. looks like 6/8 on that AWB, 2 are on AWB-GB123460001. both held by forwarder pending docs.

sophia_logistics: customs is okay, hold is purely invoice dispute. forwarder says they need a release instruction from us or vendor credit note. they're not releasing without paperwork.

maria_ops: finance needs a corrected invoice or credit note before they sign off. vendor quoted a different unit price than our committed rate.

derek_procurement: pinged vendor (SummitParts) asking for corrected invoice and confirmation on partial release. sent email and linked PO. copy of email: ```To: accounts@summitparts.com
Subject: URGENT - INV-90321 mismatch vs PO 45032
Please issue a corrected invoice or credit note referencing PO 45032 and AWB-GB123456789. Without this, goods remain on hold.
```

vendor_bot: SummitParts reply (via portal): "We acknowledge discrepancy. Finance will issue credit note within 48 hours. Shipments will remain on hold until paperwork issued. Cannot release partials from our side without adjusted docs."

amelia_supply: Ok — if vendor cannot issue partial release, can we ask forwarder to split the AWB at their depot and origin-reconsign the 2 units on separate paperwork? that's messy but might be faster. any cost impact?

sophia_logistics: depot can split but it'll incur a handling fee (~£450) + reconsignment customs docs. also increases lead time by 1-2 days.

liam_pl: cost vs time tradeoff: if we pay the handling fee we can get 4 units into Dedicated pool ASAP to cover critical jobs — estimated 12 hours from split. otherwise 48+ hours waiting on vendor credit. which is priority?

maria_ops: Priority is minimize impact to production. Can we temporarily re-route 4 units to Dedicated (non-customer) pool to absorb internal infra load, and keep 4 for customer workloads pending clearance? We need finance approval for the handling fee and for taking units early.

derek_procurement: finance is looped in — @finance_team can you confirm emergency approval threshold? If under £1k we can approve via ops lead.

vendor_bot: Update: SummitParts confirms credit note draft ready, awaiting manager signature. ETA 36 hours.

rma_bot: Automated: RMA paperwork not applicable here — no returns. but customs/forwarder hold flagged as 'DOC_MISMATCH'. ticket #DOC-77891.

amelia_supply: If credit note arrives in 36h, handling fee route not worth it. But if vendor slips, we should be ready to split. can we pre-authorize the split and only execute if no vendor docs in 18h?

maria_ops: yes, pls prepare a release playbook. steps: 1) confirm with forwarder depot they can split AWB-GB123456789 on short notice; 2) pre-raise finance approval for £500 handling fee; 3) label which units to release to Dedicated pool (serials list); 4) require vendor credit note before any customer-destined unit leaves our custody.

sophia_logistics: I'll confirm depot capability now. serials for AWB-GB123456789 are on the manifest I uploaded to #shipments earlier.

derek_procurement: vendor asked whether we can accept a post-delivery credit (net 7) instead of pre-issue — finance said no, need credit before clearing.

vendor_bot: SummitParts message: "We understand urgency. We'll escalate for same-day signature — pushing for 8 hours. If approved, we will email signed credit note and updated invoice."

liam_pl: action items: Derek monitor vendor, Sophia confirm depot split ability and cost, Amelia pre-authorize finance for handling up to £700, Maria prepare serials and routing plan. If vendor misses 20:00 UTC window, split executes. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: thanks. I'll also open a short-term capacity alert to customers that some capacity might be delayed — non-critical jobs only. will post update in #status when we have vendor doc.

derek_procurement: vendor just sent signed credit note (attached in portal). pls confirm finance ok and instruct forwarder to release.

sophia_logistics: saw it in portal. finance confirmed arrival of credit note and accepted. issuing release to forwarder now, AWB-GB123456789 cleared for delivery to our DC.

maria_ops: great — closing hold. thanks team. :raised_hands:
